title: Love Lifted Me
description: Love Lifted Me in Tonic Solfa to SAFETY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: James Rowe wrote the words and Howard E. Smith the tune; the song was published in 1912.
underlay: I was sink-ing deep in sin, Far from the peace-ful shore, Ve-ry deep-ly stained with-in, Sink-ing to rise no more; But the Mas-ter of the sea Heard my de-spair-ing cry, From the wa-ters lift-ed me— Now safe am I. Love lift-ed me, Love lift-ed me, When noth-ing else could help, Love lift-ed me_; Love lift-ed me, Love lift-ed me, When noth-ing else could help, Love lift-ed me_.

lines: I was sinking deep in sin,
But the Master of the sea
All my heart to Him I give,
Love so mighty and so true
He will lift you by His love
He’s the Master of the sea,
He your Saviour wants to be—
